name: Ameren-EMRT Big Hollow Project
monitor_reason: no data center tie: 9.6 mi (about 15 km, under 25 km) and no loaded page that names this lateral mentions data centers
researcher_notes: Re-checked under the loosened data center rule. This is a real project with a sponsor, endpoints and a concrete step. Enable Mississippi River Transmission filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission under docket CP26-2 for a 9.6 mile, 20 inch lateral from its Mainlines 2 and 3 at mile post 415.5 in Monroe County, Illinois to the Big Hollow Energy Center in Jefferson County, Missouri. The Energy Information Administration August 2026 pipeline projects workbook (Natural Gas Pipeline Projects sheet, Excel row 6) lists it as Approved, 200 MMcf/d added, in service 2028, serving electric demand. The federal notice and a November 2025 trade press story name the lateral and do not mention data centers. A February 2026 St. Louis Public Radio story says the Missouri commission approved the plant partly for expected data centers, but it does not name the pipeline. A new search found no other page that names the lateral and mentions data centers. DataCenter stays blank. Not an existing row: Mississippi River Transmission (P0162) is the whole system with no segment for this lateral. If a filing, Ameren, Energy Transfer or a shipper later ties the lateral to data centers, add it as an expansion row under Mississippi River Transmission.
